headline: Why does my soulmate keep slipping past me?
note:
Soulmate age-band batch (2026-08-19), 25-44 WHY rung. Written to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework: bubbles 3-6 run as one causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 BEREAVEMENT IS LIVE ON THIS HEADLINE. The theme pull (sm-slipping, 2026-08-19) returned widowers and widows at the top of the buyer list — 'my second wife, she passed away in 2018', 'lost my first relationship after my wife died last year'. 'Slipping past' is how a bereaved reader describes a death. So: NO MEDIUMSHIP in any form — he is not at peace, not watching, did not send her here — and NEVER say the one who went CHOSE to go.

🔴 NO SELF-BLAME. The word doing the work is KEEP: it has happened more than once, so she is the only constant and she knows it. The fear under the headline is 'I am the reason'. Nothing about walls, standards, being too picky, pushing them away, self-sabotage or attracting what she puts out. 🔴 NO STRATEGY (go out more, try the apps, work on yourself). 🔴 NO DURATION and NO DATE.

The finding that replaces the verdict: they did not get away from her. Each one stopped at the same point, just short of holding — and something steps in there.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the roses above him hang from the corners, not the middle.
You asked why your soulmate keeps slipping past. Your hand went to the man who holds his work close.
So you were never what was missing, dear. Look at that table — nothing on it is short.
And it broke at the same point every time, dear. Right before it held.
But you've gone over your own part again and again, dear.
That's why you feel it coming now, dear. Close, and then quiet.
Let me look closer at what steps in just before it lands…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his beard hangs down toward the bottom of the card.
You asked why your soulmate keeps slipping past. Your hand went to the card that stops half way.
So none of them got away from you, dear. They stopped before the end.
And this whole card is a stop, dear. Nothing in it has finished.
But you've counted each one as a loss, dear. They were stops.
That's why it never feels done, dear. Stopped and gone are not the same.
Let me look closer at what you've been left holding each time…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his collar is white and cut into points.
You asked why your soulmate keeps slipping past. Your hand went to the one still walking.
So you didn't miss them, dear. The ground ran out under each one.
And it ran out behind you, dear. Not out in front where you'd see it.
But you've searched the front of it every time, dear. For a warning.
That's why you never see it coming, dear. You watch the wrong end.
Let me look closer at what has been cutting these short each time…
